reviews.text:
What my husband and I witnessed at Dog-E-Den Hollywood last night was heartbreaking and honestly difficult to get out of my head.

We were walking past around 8:20 p.m. when I noticed an elderly Yorkie mix through the window. I recently lost my own Yorkie, so naturally this little dog caught my attention. I walked closer to the window to say hi, and that's when I realized something was very wrong.

This poor dog was struggling desperately just to stand up. Its legs kept slipping out from underneath as it was on a blue plastic-surface raised bed with no traction. It would try to get up as it needed the bathroom, and its front legs splayed out over and over so it was just stuck and very distressed and yelped for help.

It was an incredibly familiar and painful sight for me. My Yorkie suffered from IVDD, a spinal condition that affected her mobility, and I watched my own dog struggle to stand in a very similar way. I obviously don't know this dog's medical diagnosis, but watching its legs give out and seeing how difficult it was for the dog to stand reminded me immediately of what my own dog went through with her spinal injury. It honestly looked to me as though this dog could be dealing with something similar.

Meanwhile, the employee who was supposed to be supervising the dogs was sitting on the floor in the corner with no view of this dog ignoring its howls for help. She wasn't responding to this dog at all.

I stood there watching this elderly dog struggle and couldn't take it anymore. I went inside specifically to get someone to HELP THE DOG. By the time I got inside, the poor dog had urinated on itself. From what we could see, it had been trying to get off the bed and simply couldn't.

My husband was outside banging on the window trying to get the attendant's attention while I was inside asking the front desk employee to please help.

When the attendant finally noticed, she picked the dog up and rinsed it off. Watching her handle this fragile elderly dog was painful. The dog appeared to be hurting and actually snapped at her while being held.

She then cleaned/sprayed the raised bed and PUT THE DOG RIGHT BACK ON THE WET, SLIPPERY BED. The same bed this dog had already been unable to stand on. I couldn't believe what I was watching. The dog was still struggling to get traction and move and was in great distress.

What happened at the front desk made the situation even more upsetting.

I kept telling the employee, "Please go help that dog." She told me she was aware of concerns and had already expressed similar concerns to management about that employee.

Yet she STILL didn't go help.

Instead, she repeatedly asked me, "Are you okay? Are you okay?"

No. I wasn't okay. But I wasn't asking her to help me. I was begging her to help the helpless elderly dog struggling a few feet away. She didn't even seem interested in looking into the room to see what I was describing.

I was eventually told that this dog is 18 YEARS OLD and that its owners know it is elderly and they just deal with it.

Being 18 years old does not mean a dog deserves less attention or care. It means that dog needs MORE care, more patience, appropriate surfaces, careful handling, and someone actually watching it.

My husband and I were complete strangers walking down Sunset Boulevard, and WE were the ones desperately trying to get someone to notice this dog needed help. Think about that.

If the owner of this 18-year-old Yorkie mix ever reads this, or if anyone recognizes this dog, please tell the owner what happened. If this were my dog, I would desperately want someone to tell me.

I don't know this dog's medical history, and I'm not claiming that it has IVDD. I'm sharing exactly what my husband and I personally witnessed and why, based on my experience caring for a dog with serious mobility problems, what I saw was so alarming.

What we witnessed was heartbreaking. I would never feel comfortable leaving a dog I love in the care of this facility after seeing this.
Horrible customer service , not knowledgeable staff . Had a very bad experience with this place - would never trust my dog to them

This place is awful. The front desk woman (with the blue/purple hair) is extremely rude. She’s always in a bad mood and gives an attitude. I’ve also heard her yelling at my dog so I’ll never be taking my dog here again.

We’ve trusted Dog-e-Den for years for daycare and occasional overnight boarding for our dog, and our experience has been so positive that we haven’t considered anywhere else.

We like that they’re so careful about screening for temperament and health - they’ve even been the first to let us know when a vaccine is late before our vet!

Everyone we’ve encountered there has been so kind - especially Krystal - who makes me certain that our pup is good hands whenever I drop her off.

would strongly recommend avoiding this place if you value your time and reliability. I contacted them in advance because I urgently needed daycare for just a few hours due to a medical appointment I had been waiting 4 months for. I created an account, called to confirm the process, explained that online booking was not working, and was clearly told that no appointment was required and that I could simply bring my dog for a drop-in as long as I had vaccine records.

After driving 4 hours and arriving one hour before my medical procedure, I was suddenly told that my dog needed a temperament test that must be scheduled far in advance. This requirement was never mentioned during the phone call. When I explained that I was about to miss an important medical appointment, instead of offering any solution, staff suggested I “find someone else,” even though I had already explained I came from another city.

Then another employee reviewed the same vaccine documents and claimed they were not acceptable because they showed the vaccination date but not an expiration date, something that was also never communicated beforehand. In the end, 30 minutes before a serious medical procedure, they refused to take my dog and told me to search for another facility.

Because of their misinformation and lack of communication, I lost a medical appointment I had waited months for after a 4-hour drive. This experience showed a complete lack of organization, accountability, and empathy toward clients. Extremely disappointing and stressful experience.

They advertise the monthly membership by including a free grooming. When my grooming was cancelled, they refused to ACCOMMODATE me for another appointment. They offered to reschedule. However, rescheduling for a time that works for them is very different than accommodating the person who they just inconvenienced.

Not okay. I feel cheated and like my business does not matter to this place.

Dog e Den in Hollywood is absolutely amazing. The staff is so kind and they really do take amazing care of the animals. Special shoutout to Kayla - my dog absolutely ADORES her and gets really excited to see her in the morning. All of the dogs are so friendly and they all get along with each other. Another bonus is being able to watch your dog on the webcams. It’s so cute to see how much fun they are having. Really happy I found this place!

Sincerely, do not bring your dog here if you care about their well being! I dropped Sparky off here just yesterday to do a temperment test and have a day at daycare. The women at the front desk were nice upon arrival at around 1pm. Sparky passed his test and I started him at daycare that day to get him acclimated. The problems started in the evening when I went to pick Sparky up at around 6:45 pm to 7pm. The trainer who watched the dog had forgotten him in the room alone and he was not being supervised. Also Sparky was covered in shit. The final straw was when we asked to pickup our dog and the front desk person brought the wrong dog out and proceeded to give me attitude when I told him that it was not the right dog. They have no proper check in/check out system. No proper oversight of the dogs and are generally unorganized. THIS CARELESSNESS IS HOW DOGS DIE IN DAYCARE. Also, I made a reservation for daycare on September 4th and cancelled it today on the 5th after the debacle and the front desk person said they would not give my $350 deposit back a week before the boarding even though he doesn't board until the 15th (10 days before). AVOID THIS PLACE AT ALL COSTS.

Recently my dog was given a flea bath that turned literally toxic.  It irritated her skin and caused her to shake her body I  discomfort.  When I reported this to the Assist Manager she tried to find any other reason for my dog's problems other than the flea bath.  Finally, she suggested I schedule a bath  AND PAY FOR IT!  I hung up on her.  If anyone thinks this facility's action was appropriate...good luck!
Dog E Den Hollywood is GREAT!  Both my pups loved it there.  The folks watching all the pups are super sweet and loving.  Exactly where you would want your dogs to be cared for!

I love Dog-E-Den Hollywood! They have been taking care of my little chihuahua, Buckaroo, for about 2 years now. I request early drop-off because I have 12hr days. I leave his breakfast and dinner. They feed him on time every time for me.  They also let Buckaroo have down time from the other dogs for him to rest during the long day. He also stays socialized with the other dogs. Which is a good thing for our fur babies. The staff has always been kind, great communicators, and top notch, dog sitters! I highly recommend this place. I can’t give this place enough stars!
Excellent groomer, competitive pricing, great work!

Just had the preliminary behavior test, and my pup was fine. Very nice, clean place, and the folks running it are very nice. Archie will be spending most of the day with them tomorrow, I think he will be just fine. I very much like that there is a person in the play area all the time.
Always take care of my pup!
The staff is very helpful, and there's constant monitoring. I love receiving photos of my puppy, Jack!
Our first time here and we were absolutely satisfied with the service. Wendy looks all cute and ready for Christmas!

Our fur-baby Oscar loves coming here for daycare! He always drags us across the street and up the stairs to get inside. Normally he has horrible separation anxiety but we feel really comfortable leaving him at Dog-E-Den. We pick him up tired and very happy. Definitely would recommend!
They are so accommodating and patient. In love out there, and my dog loves it there.

I really love the Sherman Oaks location. The staff are fantastic and clearly love dogs and their jobs. Unfortunately, I recently moved away from the area. The Hollywood location feels like an entirely different business. The staff don’t appear to know the dogs and are largely  unfriendly and unwelcoming. The purple haired receptionist is very rude and has no business working in customer service. I will be taking my business elsewhere.

Super conveniently located DOG-E-DEN is a life saver with 3 chaotic dogs.  They allow for easy drop offs and pick ups with no reservations which is perfect for my spontaneous lifestyle.  Dogs are so happy to go and so tired when picked up.  win/win. thank you to all the trainers.  they are sweet and genuine.  echo/bijou
The groomer gave my pup such a great fresh cut. Listened to everything we talked about in the consult. Everyone is so nice.

Dog-E-Den Hollywood is the best! I started taking my 1 year old dog there M-F about a month and a half ago. He has the best time, and is so excited to get there and play with his new friends every morning. The staff is all very friendly and they keep the dog area very clean throughout the day. I love that I can check in on my baby via the cameras and the daily report cards with photos are a nice touch. Highly recommend if you're looking for a good daycare option for your pup.
They were very friendly. They got my baby in same week and accommodated me on short notice. The cut turned out beautiful.
Can always count on my pup to be treated like a star at Dog E Den.

They took great care of my dog when she had to go to the vet for an infection (which started before I brought her to DogeDen. They brought her to the vet and made sure she took her meds afterwards. I was so glad to know that she was well taken care of while I was thousands of miles away.

Dog e den has been a life saver! Our pup has separation anxiety and can't be left alone. We rely on Dog e den to take good care of him and he always has a human around. The people that work there are friendly and confident with dogs. He …
